# @dxtmisha/functional

> Comprehensive library of utilities, base classes, and Vue 3 composables for reactive web development.

Extends `@dxtmisha/functional-basic` with Composition API primitives, reactive API management (`useApiRef`), state singletons (`executeUse`), browser storage synchronization, and internationalization composables.

## Key Modules & Composables

- [executeUseGlobal / executeUseLocal / executeUseProvide](src/functions/executeUse.ts): Scope-isolated singleton factories for service state, decoupled business logic, and API management.
- [useApiRef / useApiManagementRef / useApiManagementAsyncRef](src/composables/ref/useApiManagementRef.ts): Reactive HTTP client composables with loading tracking, caching, pagination, client-side search, and SSR prefetching.
- [useStorageRef / useSessionRef / useCookieRef / useBroadcastValueRef](src/composables/ref/useStorageRef.ts): Reactive wrappers for LocalStorage, SessionStorage, cookies, and BroadcastChannel with automatic cross-tab synchronization.
- [useHashRef / useQueryRef](src/composables/ref/useQueryRef.ts): Reactive URL hash and query string parameter synchronization composables.
- [useGeoIntlRef / useGeoUnitRef / useTranslateRef](src/composables/ref/useGeoIntlRef.ts): Locale-aware reactive formatting for numbers, dates, currencies, units, and dynamic translation loader (`t`).
- [useSearchRef / useSearchValueRef / ListDataRef](src/composables/ref/useSearchRef.ts): Debounced multi-field search and reactive list data model with selection state management.
- [useLazyRef / useLazyItemByMarginRef](src/composables/ref/useLazyRef.ts): IntersectionObserver composable for lazy rendering and viewport visibility tracking.
- [DesignConstructorAbstract / DesignComponents](src/classes/design/DesignConstructorAbstract.ts): Class-based architectural primitives for creating token-driven component constructors with automatic lifecycle and prop bindings.
- [useMeta](src/composables/ref/useMeta.ts): Reactive document `<title>`, Open Graph, and Twitter Cards synchronization.
- [computedAsync / computedEternity](src/functions/computedAsync.ts): Async computed property helpers for resolving promises and caching asynchronous evaluations.
- [dxtFunctionalPlugin](src/functions/dxtFunctionalPlugin.ts): Vue application plugin registering global configuration, router binding, and social media icons.
